steps.policy: Only runtime-discovered automation-ready capabilities may become plan candidates. Discovery never invokes a plugin.

One sealed edit-plan/v4 per chapter, written against the unchanged base project. Its materialEvidence is exactly this chapter's semantic receipts, route.format is longform, and every editorial frame stays inside the chapter's integer [startFrame, endFrame) range. No chapter renders.
Local, deterministic: the controller recomputes the set from the completed chapter receipts and the unchanged base project; a changed chapter file is rejected.

steps.machine_certification: forbidden; explicit agent authority permits artifact-bound visual review only

invariants: One long-form video is one Editkin project, one atomic set apply and one render. Revision 6 stays the bound execution contract; its bytes and Editkin's sealed identity never change for this session.
Every chapter seals its own edit-plan/v4 against the same base project revision. Chapters never ripple: pause and retake cuts must already be in the base project.
A chapter plan carries exactly its own chapter's material receipts and keeps every beat, graphic, transition, audio accent and colour exception frame inside its integer [startFrame, endFrame) range.

The plan step seals the chapter set locally and deterministically; audit_longform_plan_set and apply_longform_plan_set receive projectPath and the exact planSet (chapter plans travel as path plus sha).

apply_longform_plan_set is one atomic mutation that advances the project by exactly one revision with one committed receipt. An interrupted claim becomes reconcile_required and is never retried automatically.
There is no per-chapter render step. Captions stay an editable project track and are burned only by the single final render_project.
Original Motion sources, owner revisions and source relinks are refused in v1 sets.
Visual review and outcome are unchanged: the bound creator policy decides the reviewer, and outcome attribution finds the set's committed receipt by its planSha256.
